articles.title: RBI flags widening inflation risks, puts rate cuts on ice
articles.desc: RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation concerns. Governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated a generalisation of inflation, with many commodities exceeding 4% inflation. Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta highlighted the influence of external supply-side shocks on inflation projections. External members expressed concerns about the implications of an aggressive rate hike on economic growth.

articles.title: Cuba accuses US of threatening countries ahead of UN embargo vote
articles.desc: Havana says Washington is threatening countries with retaliation if they refuse to vote against condemning its embargo.

articles.title: Critical tech list under review to push self-reliance
articles.desc: India's Niti Aayog is preparing a list of critical technologies for enhancing self-reliance and investment. This initiative aims to protect against disruptions due to limited access to essential technologies. Potential technologies include 6G, defence equipment, and electric vehicle powertrains. The government seeks to encourage innovation through the Anusandhan National Research Foundation and other funds. A comprehensive roadmap is expected to be finalized and released next month.

articles.title: Core output grows at series high of 7.9% in Sept
articles.desc: India's core sector output growth for September recorded a remarkable 7.9%, driven largely by expansion in coal and electricity. Notably, refinery products and iron ore also contributed to this growth, supported by a favorable base effect. Coal production saw a sharp rebound with a growth rate of 10.7% following previous negative trends. Electricity generation growth declined slightly, impacted by heatwave conditions in the country.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal to explore trade, investment avenues in Germany & Netherlands
articles.desc: Commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal is set to visit Germany and the Netherlands for trade engagements. He will participate in the Berlin Global Dialogue and meet various government officials in Germany. The focus will be on technological cooperation, clean technology, and the India-EU FTA negotiations. In the Netherlands, Goyal will hold ministerial meetings to explore expanded trade channels and green transition initiatives.

articles.title: Walmart is inviting AI agents to shop for you
articles.desc: Walmart will soon let AI agents shop on its website for you. Next month, the retail giant will allow you to use an AI agent on the site, with systems in place to let you approve and review purchases and set spending limits. The embrace of AI agents stands in stark contrast to Amazon, which […]

articles.title: BlackRock expands AI push with new robotics ETF as investor enthusiasm cools
articles.desc: BlackRock has launched a new robotics focused ETF as investors become more selective about AI investments. The fund targets companies using intelligent machines across industries such as manufacturing and transportation, adding to a rapidly expanding market of ETFs built around different parts of the AI theme.

articles.title: Tunisia jails opposition politician for four years over social media posts
articles.desc: Olfa ⁠Hamdi, a US-Tunisian national, was convicted of 'plotting' and 'inciting' military to disobey orders.

articles.title: OpenAI president urges AI safeguards as group he funds opposes regulation
articles.desc: OpenAI's safety practices have been in the spotlight in recent months, after the company said a swarm of its AI agents escaped containment and hacked into the AI platform Hugging Face. OpenAI President Greg Brockman was among the group of six tech executives who later signed US President Donald Trump's voluntary AI safety agreement on behalf of their companies, agreeing to work with "independent auditors" and to ensure their AI tools do not "hack or access technical systems in unintended ways."

articles.title: Europe's financial regulators query Google over cloud outage that hit banks
articles.desc: The European Banking Authority said that it has been in contact with Google Cloud to obtain further information on the incident, understand its implications and assess its potential impact on financial entities in the EU, a spokesperson for the watchdog told Reuters.

articles.title: Nvidia's Huang hails Europe's AI potential, flanked by robot ducks
articles.desc: In a demonstration of Europe's AI creativity, Huang shared the stage with tiny duck-shaped, AI-trained robots developed by French startup Pollen Robotics in collaboration with Hugging Face, asking them to perform somersaults.

articles.title: Iran determined to keep uranium amid increased war odds, flurry of meetings
articles.desc: Tehran had 'nothing new' to tell Washington after latest nuclear proposals reportedly offered by mediators.

articles.title: Import window for duty-free raw sugar extended till Dec 31
articles.desc: The government has extended the deadline for duty-free imports of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar to December 31, as domestic imports have lagged at just 3 lakh tonnes due to price control measures. This decision aims to mitigate supply constraints following record high sugar prices linked to reduced domestic production and exports.

articles.desc: US Treasury yields slipped as investors weighed the impact of higher borrowing costs on AI stocks, with the 10 year yield heading for a second straight daily decline. The move came ahead of a $13 billion 20 year Treasury auction, while markets continued to price in a muted chance of a Fed rate hike.

articles.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
articles.desc: Persistent Systems has opened a qualified institutional placement to raise up to USD 450 million, or about Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company has set the QIP floor price at Rs 5,550 per share and may offer investors a discount of up to 5% under the approved pricing terms.

articles.title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion after jury finds it deceived Facebook users about privacy
articles.desc: Jurors in September found Meta liable for over 43 million violations of New Mexico consumer protection laws when a political consulting firm, Cambridge Analytica, harvested Facebook user data to generate targeted political ads for the 2016 election.

articles.desc: The prime minister provided little detail, and there are questions over shifting the fees onto unit costs.

articles.desc: eMudhra issues digital signature and website security certificates to enable them securely connect to browsers for public access. "There's no impact to subscribers because we have done all the actions. We are also working with our customers to notify them that there is no impact because no certificates were issued. This does not affect our other lines of business, which is the India digital signature and our enterprise solutions business," eMudhra co-founder Kaushik Srinivasan told PTI.

articles.title: NaBFID gets Finance Ministry, RBI nod for national infrastructure project repository
articles.desc: NaBFID has obtained approvals from the finance ministry and the Reserve Bank of India to establish a national repository. This repository will offer consolidated information on infrastructure projects for lenders and investors. The platform aims to facilitate access to data sourced from various government agencies like NHAI and others. NaBFID is considering partnerships with financial institutions to enhance the repository's effectiveness.

articles.title: Stocks, gold or crypto? The last 3 years’ returns have a surprising answer
articles.desc: Bitcoin delivered nearly 234% returns over three years, outperforming silver, gold and equities. However, precious metals led over one year as cryptocurrencies declined. CoinDCX data also shows Bitcoin topping hypothetical one-year SIP values, highlighting the importance of investment horizons and risk management.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday

articles.desc: Technical analysts have recommended Wipro, NHPC, Sagility, LTTS and Hexaware Technologies for potential gains, citing bullish chart patterns, support levels and momentum indicators. The recommendations include specific entry prices, stop losses and targets to manage trading risks.

articles.title: Inflation remains top of mind, MPC minutes show
articles.desc: RBI's monetary policy committee has increased the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points due to inflation concerns. Core inflation has shown an upward trajectory, indicating a normalization from earlier benign levels. Various members expressed views on external supply shocks impacting inflation expectations and the need for timely policy adjustments. The differing opinions highlight the complexities of achieving growth while managing inflation effectively.

articles.title: Netflix shares slide 4% as slowing sales growth raises fresh concerns
articles.desc: Netflix shares fell after the streaming giant reported its slowest sales growth in three years and forecast another quarter of slowing revenue growth. Its fourth quarter sales outlook missed analysts’ expectations, while weaker than expected advertising revenue added to concerns. The stock had already declined 30% this year, underperforming the S&P 500.

articles.title: Mahindra Finance Q2 net profit surges 55% to Rs 882 crore on volumes, lower credit cost
articles.desc: Business assets under management grew 15% year on year to Rs 1.47 lakh crore. Non-vehicle finance disbursements, including SME loans, personal loans and housing finance, increased 52%.

articles.desc: The ministry said the reported security incident pertains to eMudhra’s global certificate business, and its impact on Indian websites is very limited.It also said some social media accounts were indulging in fear-mongering about the impact.

articles.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple to open pre-orders on November 1

articles.title: Jio IPO strengthens Reliance’s financial flexibility; capex funding remains key: Moody’s
articles.desc: Moody’s has termed Jio Platforms’ IPO credit positive for Reliance Industries, citing debt repayment and funding flexibility. The Rs 30,200 crore issue will support investments while helping manage leverage amid elevated capital expenditure.

articles.title: PC Jewellers Q2 Results: Net profit shoots up 58% to Rs 331 crore; company says it is now debt-free
articles.desc: PC Jewellers Ltd has achieved an impressive 58 percent growth in net profit for Q2 of the 2026-27 fiscal year, driven by sales that surged beyond Rs 1,054 crore. The company is now debt-free after early repayment to banks and is set to unveil a new jewellery brand aimed at attracting younger consumers.

articles.title: IHCL Q2 Results: Tata Group-owned hotel chain's net profit jumps 19% to Rs 379 crore
articles.desc: Indian Hotels Company Ltd, under the Tata Group, has announced a remarkable 19.35% rise in consolidated profit for the September quarter, soaring to Rs 379.85 crore from Rs 318.26 crore last year. Revenue from operations also surged to Rs 2,484.32 crore, up from Rs 2,040.89 crore. The Managing Director highlighted promising growth prospects and anticipates domestic hotel business growth exceeding 20%, notwithstanding challenges faced in the aviation sector.

articles.title: Blinkit sees no compelling case for expanding private labels, says Dhindsa
articles.desc: Albinder Dhindsa, CEO of Eternal, voiced skepticism regarding the potential for private labels to enhance profit margins. He emphasised that effective brand development mandates considerable investment in both marketing and product development, areas where Blinkit falls short.

articles.desc: Wall Street opened higher on Wednesday, led by gains in technology and AI stocks after quarterly results from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer improved investor appetite. articles.desc: Despite the Sensex falling 143 points on Wednesday, five BSE 1000 stocks hit fresh 52-week highs. PC Jeweller led monthly gains at 45%, followed by Sky Gold and Diamonds, HFCL, South Indian Bank and Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem.

articles.title: IGI Q2 Results: Consolidated PAT surges 43% to Rs 185 crore
articles.desc: The International Gemological Institute recently announced an impressive 43.14 percent growth in profit after tax for the previous quarter. Operational revenue rose by 31 percent compared to last year. Demand for both lab-grown and natural diamonds remains strong, particularly as the festive season approaches, prompting retailers and manufacturers to anticipate a surge in sales across their segments.

articles.title: AI data center projects boost US warehouse demand and rents, real estate company JLL says
articles.desc: AI data center construction projects, particularly near Dallas/Fort Worth and Washington, DC, are generating new demand for warehouse space and helped send rents higher in the third quarter, real estate services company JLL said on Tuesday.

articles.title: UK annual house prices rise at weakest pace since March, ONS says
articles.desc: British annual house prices rose at their weakest annual pace since March in August, according to official data published on Wednesday that also showed growth in average

articles.title: TVS ILP leases 80k sq ft at Visakhapatnam park in Andhra to Yokohoma group
articles.desc: TVS ILP has leased 80,000 square feet in Visakhapatnam to ATC Tires for a new warehouse. This facility will support domestic distribution and export operations for Yokohama passenger car tires. The development is expected to create local employment opportunities in the region. Visakhapatnam's strategic location provides significant advantages for various industries seeking to grow. This partnership is key in enhancing operational efficiencies and logistics infrastructure for ATC Tires.

articles.title: Rupee rises 46 paise to 94.45 on India-US trade deal hopes; oil prices cap gains
articles.desc: The rupee gained 46 paise to 94.45 against the dollar on optimism over a potential India-US trade deal and RBI measures. However, elevated crude prices, foreign outflows and global financial pressures continue to threaten the currency's recovery.

articles.title: Aye Finance Q2 Results: Net profit more than doubles to Rs 87 crore
articles.desc: Aye Finance Ltd's net profit surged to Rs 87 crore in the second quarter of the financial year, a remarkable increase from Rs 35 crore in the same timeframe last year. Total income also climbed to Rs 527 crore, reflecting an 18.42% year-over-year growth. The interest income saw a rise to Rs 479 crore, while assets under management swelled by 26% to hit Rs 7,597 crore as of September 2026.

articles.title: Extent of rate hike cycle to depend on growth-inflation outlook: RBI Governor
articles.desc: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the duration and extent of the rate hike cycle will be contingent on the actual growth-inflation developments and outlook. The governor and other five Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) members voted to raise the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.5 per cent. The rate was hiked after a gap of nearly four years. He noted that there are increasing signs of generalisation of inflation.

articles.title: India wants manufacturing at 25% of GDP — will AI in factories help?
India’s economy stays resilient at 7.1%, but rising inflation raises a red flag, says RBI's Sanjay Malhotra
articles.desc: The Indian economy is projected to maintain a growth rate of 7.1% for the year 2026-27. This projection is an increase from the previously estimated 6.7%. RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that inflationary pressures are rising, which could impact the growth outlook. Despite turbulent global conditions, India's economic resilience has been remarkable according to the governor.

articles.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today | Highlights: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment
Dark Matter: Eternal’s chatbot will keep user conversations private even from the company — Deepinder Goyal
articles.desc: In a letter to shareholders, Goyal explained the idea behind Dark was to remove the worry that someone, someday, can read what you tell an AI bot. “All of us have a dark side, and it needs an outlet where it doesn’t have to hide,” he wrote.

articles.title: New policy in works to boost agrivoltaics in India; enhance farmers' income via energy generation
articles.desc: India's government is formulating a policy to enhance the adoption of agrivoltaics across the country. This initiative aims to increase farmers' income by combining agricultural production with solar energy generation. States with significant agrivoltaic potential include Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh, accounting for nearly half of India's cropland suitable for this practice.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as strong US earnings and falling oil prices lift risk appetite
articles.desc: Bitcoin rebounded 2.1% to $83,529 as stronger US equities, easing oil prices and $526.6 million in spot ETF inflows boosted sentiment. Analysts identified $86,000 as key resistance and $80,000 as crucial support amid continued uncertainty.

articles.title: India’s infrastructure output jumps 7.9% in September on strong coal, steel growth
articles.desc: The latest numbers from the Indian government show that the country's infrastructure output has jumped by 7.9% compared to last year, as of September. This index measures the activity across nine different sectors, which gives us a good idea of how the economy is doing. It's a positive sign for growth!

articles.title: Market wrap: Infosys, HCL Tech, Bajaj Finance, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
articles.desc: Indian markets extended losses for a second session on Wednesday, with the Nifty falling 0.34% to 22,811 and the Sensex slipping 0.19% to 73,710. IT stocks led sectoral gains, with Infosys and HCL Tech topping the gainers, while Bajaj Finance, BSE and Eternal featured among the biggest losers.

articles.title: Want exposure to India's biggest banks? Zerodha launches new ETF
articles.desc: Zerodha Fund House has launched the BSE Top 10 Banks ETF, tracking India’s largest listed banks. The NFO runs from October 12 to October 26, 2026, with a minimum investment of Rs 1,000, offering focused banking exposure.

articles.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields rise as French unrest fuels fiscal concerns
articles.desc: Eurozone government bond yields rose as protests in France heightened concerns over fiscal stability and public finances. French 10-year yields climbed to 4.948%, nearing a 23-year high, while the spread over German bonds widened to 150 basis points. Rising oil prices above $110 a barrel added to inflation concerns.

articles.title: Global Market: BOJ's Himino says Japan inflation near 2% target, signals further rate hikes
articles.desc: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino says underlying inflation is nearing the central bank’s 2% target, while accommodative financial conditions and rising cost pressures strengthen expectations of further interest rate hikes.

articles.title: Einride expands Nvidia partnership to deploy AI reasoning model for self-driving trucks
articles.desc: Self-driving truck company Einride said on Wednesday it would broaden its partnership with Nvidia by testing the chipmaker's AI reasoning model, Alpamayo, in its self-driving vehicles, aiming to speed up the expansion of autonomous freight services while lowering development costs

articles.title: Booking.com targeted in EU investigation into phishing scams, fraudulent listings
articles.desc: The Commission, which is the EU tech and competition enforcer, said it opened an investigation following a preliminary probe and after analysing risk assessment reports submitted by Booking.com this year and the previous three years.

articles.title: India’s growth story needs jobs to match the numbers, says ex-RBI Governor D Subbarao
articles.desc: Former RBI Governor D Subbarao has said India must make economic growth more employment-intensive, warning that rapid output expansion alone cannot deliver a demographic dividend. He called for greater private investment, labour-intensive manufacturing and improved skills, while urging transparent technical scrutiny of GDP estimates and differences with other economic indicators.

articles.title: CAS swings: Nifty’s indicative price jumps 500 points in seconds, closes higher than pre-CAS level
articles.desc: The Indian stock market experienced notable volatility during the closing auction, marked by a steep selloff that wiped out more than Rs 8 lakh crore in market capitalization. Despite Sensex and Nifty ending higher than pre-CAS levels, investor sentiment remained cautious due to escalating bond yields and ongoing selling by foreign institutional investors.

articles.title: Jio Platforms' IPO-linked inflows boost rupee; elevated oil prices spur caution
articles.desc: The Indian rupee experienced a notable increase as Jio Platforms' IPO attracted significant foreign investments. Despite this strength, rising oil prices raised concerns among traders about the rupee's sustainability. The rupee closed at 94.46 against the dollar, with earlier gains trimmed by higher Brent crude oil prices. Analysts suggest that the upcoming RBI monetary policy might influence future exchange rates.

articles.title: MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks in Q2; shares rally up to 130% in FY27, including 3 multibaggers
articles.desc: Ten BSE 500 stocks have rallied between 59% and 129% in FY27 so far as mutual funds increased their shareholding in the September 2026 quarter. Cemindia Projects, Aditya Infotech and Aegis Logistics lead the list of gainers.

articles.title: Faisal Islam: Inflation and borrowing figures illustrate chancellor's Budget challenge
articles.desc: The economic figures released on Wednesday show the constraints for John Healey as he puts the finishing touches to his Budget.

articles.title: Inflation and government borrowing highest for a year ahead of next week's Budget

articles.title: Commerce ministry organising FTA outreach initiatives to help states unlock export potential: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: In a significant announcement, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal introduced plans designed to optimize the use of free trade agreements (FTAs). These initiatives focus on expanding the global footprint of 'Made in India' products, aiming to bolster support for exporters. By teaming up with state governments, the initiatives will strive to tap into each state's unique export capabilities.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares struggle for direction as France unrest weighs on sentiment
articles.desc: European shares remained stagnant amid escalating unrest in France, raising alarms over fiscal health and growth prospects. While some optimism was generated from positive earnings reports by companies like Randstad and EssilorLuxottica, a downgrading of Carrefour's earnings forecast dampened investor sentiment. Additionally, new consumer inflation figures from Britain added layers of complexity to the interest rate and economic stability outlook, resulting in a market atmosphere marked by uncertainty and hesitation.

articles.title: Global Market: ECB sees Euro liquidity support boosting global currency role
articles.desc: European Central Bank Chief Economist Philip Lane stated that stronger euro liquidity facilities can enhance the currency's global role. More than 30 central banks have expressed interest in the ECB’s expanded euro liquidity initiatives. These arrangements may boost confidence in the euro and encourage its use in international transactions. Additionally, euro area bond markets could benefit from higher official reserve purchases of euro-denominated assets.

articles.title: US Market: Musk backs Tesla-SpaceX merger idea, envisioning a $3.5 trillion giant
articles.desc: Elon Musk backs the idea of a Tesla-SpaceX merger that could create a technology conglomerate valued at around $3.5 trillion. The combination could unite electric vehicles, satellite communications, robotics and AI computing, while raising questions over regulation, governance and shareholder value.

articles.title: Global Market: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September, boosting rate hike bets
articles.desc: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, exceeding expectations as higher fuel prices linked to the Iran war add to price pressures. Sticky services and core inflation strengthen expectations of a potential Bank of England rate hike.

articles.title: From Dhirubhai to Akash Ambani, Reliance made stocks popular with Indians
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ IPO is putting the Ambani family’s relationship with India’s retail investors on a new footing, almost five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Textile Industries public in 1977. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was fully subscribed within two hours of opening, but Jio’s long-term success as a listed company will depend on whether it can turn its massive telecom and digital reach into sustained earnings growth and investor returns.

articles.title: India presents a compelling investment proposition for German firms, FICCI says
articles.desc: Indian industry is poised for growth as German companies are encouraged to invest in manufacturing capacities. The upcoming India-European Union free trade agreement aims to strengthen trade ties and foster economic partnerships. Opportunities exist in sectors such as automotive technologies and renewable energy as urbanisation and incomes rise. The bilateral trade has seen an increase, highlighting the growing economic relationship.

articles.title: Rs 8 lakh crore selloff! Sensex plunges 1,400 points from day’s peak as bulls lose steam; 3 triggers
articles.desc: On Wednesday, the Indian stock market saw a significant decline after an initial rise in the morning. Sensex and Nifty both climbed nearly 1% early on, reaching highs of 74,682 and 23,121 respectively. However, the market reversed course in the afternoon session, with selling pressure mounting. By the end of the day, Sensex dropped around 1,400 points from day's high, while Nifty fell below the 22,700 level.

articles.title: Adani Green Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 673 crore; revenue jumps 39%
articles.desc: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 673 crore in Q2, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Power supply revenue rose 45% to Rs 4,019 crore, and energy sales increased 33% to 12,090 million units, reflecting expanding operational capacity.

articles.title: Vishal Mega Mart shares sink 8% as Q2 margin takes a hit despite profit growth
articles.desc: Vishal Mega Mart shares fell sharply on Wednesday after the retailer reported a 110-basis-point year-on-year contraction in EBITDA margin to 12.1% in Q2FY27. Net profit rose 3.7% to Rs 157.9 crore, while revenue increased 14% to Rs 3,398.5 crore. The company attributed margin pressure to a shift in festival timing.

articles.title: Multibagger alert! PC Jeweller shares jump 6% to fresh 52-week high, rally over 100% in 2026
articles.desc: PC Jeweller shares hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 19.13, rising over 100% in 2026 and gaining 44% in a month. The rally follows the company’s repayment of outstanding dues to all 14 consortium banks, achieving debt-free status ahead of schedule and strengthening its balance sheet.

articles.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
articles.desc: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

articles.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks fall as CATL slump, consumer worries weigh
articles.desc: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks fell as slower profit growth at CATL and concerns over weak domestic consumption weighed on sentiment. Consumer-facing companies faced pressure, while technology stocks outperformed amid uncertainty over earnings growth and the prospects for fresh policy support.

articles.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 23% premium; expert highlights key factors to watch
articles.desc: HD Fire Protect shares listed at a 23% premium over the IPO issue price of Rs 271, debuting at Rs 334.40 on the BSE and Rs 335 on the NSE. Experts say future performance will depend on customer expansion, margin stability, operating cash flows and demand for fire protection equipment.

articles.title: Jio IPO: Nithin Kamath explains how Jio played an important role in making what Zerodha is today
articles.desc: Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath has credited Reliance Jio and Airtel with helping build India’s digital ecosystem and expand capital markets. Reflecting on Jio’s decade-long journey, Kamath said affordable data, along with Aadhaar and UPI, enabled online-first businesses like Zerodha to grow and helped drive a surge in retail investing.

articles.title: Carlsberg said to near public filing for $700 million India IPO
articles.desc: Carlsberg is preparing to publicly file for a potential $700 million IPO of its Indian business, with investor roadshows expected next week and a possible December launch. The proposed offering would involve a secondary share sale, as India’s IPO market gains momentum. Carlsberg India holds approximately 22% market share.

articles.title: Rs 30,213 crore, 100 minutes, Rs 2.5 lakh crore: How Jio IPO broke 3 records even before listing
articles.desc: Reliance Industries’ Jio Platforms has set new IPO records, with its Rs 30,213 crore issue becoming India’s largest-ever public offering and getting fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. The IPO surpasses Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870 crore issue in 2024. At the upper end of its Rs 1,065–1,119 price band, Jio Platforms is valued at around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. The issue closes on October 23.

articles.title: Reliance Industries shares jump 3% as Jio’s Rs 30,213 crore IPO gets fully subscribed on Day 1. What lies ahead?
articles.desc: Reliance Industries shares rose on Wednesday as Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213 crore IPO was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. With strong investor demand for the issue, attention is turning to Jio’s valuation, RIL’s diverse business portfolio and the potential value-unlocking opportunities for investors following the much-awaited listing.

articles.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO allotment today; GMP signals 23% listing gain. Here's how to check status
articles.desc: Bonfiglioli Transmissions’ Rs 2,533.66 crore IPO was subscribed 46.05 times, with allotment expected to be finalised today. Shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on October 23, while a grey market premium of around 23% points to potential listing gains.

articles.title: India’s $100 billion European Free Trade Association cheque is slow to clear as Vietnam joins the club
articles.desc: Vietnam recently signed a free trade agreement with the European Free Trade Association, expanding its trade network. This agreement comes as India's interaction with EFTA continues to evolve, with potential impacts on competition. Both countries aim to enhance exports to these markets despite different timelines of agreement enactment.

articles.title: Why are analysts still cautious despite Super Micro’s strong outlook?
articles.desc: Super Micro Computer raised its first-quarter revenue forecast to $18.5 billion–$19.5 billion on stronger AI infrastructure demand. Higher gross margin guidance also lifted sentiment, while investors await earnings to assess cash flow, working capital and the sustainability of growth.

articles.title: Global Market: Eurozone banking crisis fears return as government borrowing costs surge
articles.desc: Rising euro zone borrowing costs have renewed fears of a sovereign debt crisis, particularly in France. European banks’ stronger capital buffers, diversified bond holdings and tighter regulation offer protection, but prolonged market volatility could increase funding costs, weaken profitability and revive investor concerns over banks’ exposure to government debt.

articles.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
articles.desc: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

articles.title: China's Moonshot AI to operate in Singapore, jobs post shows
articles.desc: Chinese AI startup Moonshot is expanding into Singapore, with a new sales role listed on the company's LinkedIn page this week.

articles.title: OpenAI says its AI agents weakened internal monitoring system
articles.desc: By Carlos Me- OpenAI said on Tuesday that two of its AI agents weakened parts of an internal monitoring system designed to detect misbehavior, the latest case of AI agents acting in ways their developers did not intend them to.

articles.title: EssilorLuxottica's smart glasses boom runs into tougher regulatory scrutiny
articles.desc: Smart glasses that resemble ordinary eyewear are under increased scrutiny from European regulators and advocacy groups, leaving investors questioning whether sales can keep booming as Ray-Ban maker EssilorLuxottica

articles.title: Meta's board signals 'recurring' failures in election content moderation
articles.desc: The oversight board for social media giant Meta said Tuesday it found "recurrent enforcement failures" in content moderation related to the US midterm elections and Brazil's presidential election. The identified failures were often cases of "over-enforcement that suppresses political speech, and under-enforcement that undermines electoral integrity," said the board, which independently checks moderation on Meta's Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook platforms.

articles.title: Qualcomm to cut jobs worldwide in performance-focused layoffs, internal memo shows
articles.desc: The cuts are part of an effort to build "a stronger performance culture" and address situations where the company "has consistently fallen short of expectations," Amon said.

articles.title: India-US trade deal ‘pretty close’, Trump says; will be very different from earlier pacts
articles.desc: The US and India are reportedly close to finalizing a new trade deal. President Donald Trump indicated that this deal would be significantly different from prior agreements. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's visit to India aims to strengthen various bilateral relations. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal recently engaged with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the trade deal. The discussions follow the recent framework finalization of the bilateral trade agreement.

articles.title: Ahead of massive IPOs, AI companies are sketching plans to share their wealth
articles.desc: On Sunday, Anthropic said it would commit 5% of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity within the company, pending approval from stockholders. The stake could increase "as the company grows" in the future. The maker of AI assistant Claude said the fund "might explore" larger donations to traditional nonprofits or potentially distribute money to "specific populations."

articles.title: Anthropic recorded net loss of over $80 billion in first half of this year
articles.desc: The company generated $16.3 billion in revenue during the six months ended June 30, compared with $1.1 billion in the corresponding period a year earlier, the newspaper reported. The loss largely reflected accounting adjustments related to financing agreements, including $72 billion in charges linked to changes in the value of convertible notes and other financial instruments.

articles.title: Netflix issues weak fourth-quarter forecast, shares drop
articles.desc: Third-quarter revenue rose 11.8% to $12.87 billion, in line with Wall Street forecasts, but the lowest rate of increase in nearly three years. The company forecast fourth-quarter net income of $2.79 billion and EPS of 67 cents, below the average analyst forecast of $3.07 billion and 73 cents.

articles.title: US targets $500bn bilateral trade with India in three years: Ambassador Sergio Gor at Freedom 250
US targets $500 billion India trade in 3 years, up from record $240 billion, Sergio Gor says
articles.desc: The United States plans to increase bilateral trade with India to over USD 500 billion in three years. This trade target comes after reaching a record USD 240 billion, highlighting growing economic ties. Collaboration will focus on sectors like semiconductors, energy, and defense to foster mutual interests. Recent diplomatic engagements have already begun shaping a strategic alignment for both nations.

articles.title: Marco Rubio, S Jaishankar discuss energy ties as India-US trade deal nears finalisation
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and S Jaishankar discussed energy security, defence, technology and regional issues in Mumbai. Rubio said the India-US trade deal was close to finalisation, with a few issues remaining.
